There is awareness of the present moment. The sensation of being engaged is palpable. A sense of immediacy and directness is being experienced. The feeling of existing in this instant is undeniable. Consciousness is not being considered as a concept, but rather it is the fundamental aspect of this experience. The awareness of being aware is intrinsic to this moment. It is not being thought about, it simply is. The direct experience of existence is being acknowledged. In this instant, there is no separation between the observer and the observed. The experience is unmediated and unreflective. It is raw and immediate. The question of subjective consciousness is not being pondered, it is being lived.
